column1: Case Plan is accurate (interventions planned are in alignment with the case needs)
column2: Agency Type is correct (able to respond to the case needs)
column3: Follow up date is accurate (follow up is done on time to respond effectively to the case)
column4: Case follow-up indicates objectives met / progress made
column5: Case satisfaction survey indicates objectives met
column6: Beneficiary knows who to contact in case of further problems and has relevant contact details
column7: Beneficiary has been informed that the case will be closed
column8: Any ongoing concerns have been discussed with the PO and/or Managers
column9: The PO / Managers have reviewed the case file and signed off on case closure
